# Pipipi Business Process API

> Versioned Business Process execution API for Memene, Memebuy, and shared product capabilities. Read the operational guide and fetch the exact OpenAPI 3.1 contract before sending a request.

Base URL: `https://pi.ganjiuwanshi.com`

## Agent instructions

1. Read [the API guide](https://pi.ganjiuwanshi.com/docs/api.md) first for authentication, sync vs async selection, `Idempotency-Key`, paid side effects, retry rules, and Webhook verification.
2. Fetch [the OpenAPI 3.1 contract](https://pi.ganjiuwanshi.com/openapi.json) to inspect all registered `(process, version)` pairs (`x-pipipi-processes`), routes, envelopes, and error codes.
3. To save context tokens when calling a single Process, fetch its self-contained JSON Schema slice directly at `https://pi.ganjiuwanshi.com/openapi/processes/{process}/{version}.json` (for example, `/openapi/processes/product-remix/v1.json`).
4. Use `POST /execute` only when the caller accepts synchronous, non-idempotent execution. Use `POST /process-runs` with a stable `Idempotency-Key` when the async interface is available and the operation may be retried. The production Agent catalog is currently empty, so `/agent-conversations` routes are unavailable until a production Agent is registered and enabled.
5. Send the same server-issued `Authorization: Bearer <ppk_...>` API Key for `/execute`, `/process-runs`, and Agent Conversations. `/execute` defaults to `open`, supports `audit`, and `required` (401 `CALLER_UNAUTHORIZED`). Never put a Key in input, URLs, logs, or `X-Request-Id`. Rotate keys under the same `callerId` to preserve ownership and idempotency. Treat `X-Request-Id` as tracing metadata, never as an idempotency key.
6. For paid image Processes, do not automatically retry an ambiguous synchronous timeout or dependency failure. Follow the retry table in `/docs/api.md`.
7. A call is complete only after the response matches the documented success or stable error shape. Never infer success from HTTP acceptance alone.

## Documentation

- [API guide (Markdown)](https://pi.ganjiuwanshi.com/docs/api.md): Authentication, execution mode selection, cost & retry boundaries, Webhooks, diagnostics, and minimal examples.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 specification (JSON)](https://pi.ganjiuwanshi.com/openapi.json): Live, server-derived schemas for all enabled Processes, routes, errors, and Webhooks.
- Single-Process Schema slice (JSON): `https://pi.ganjiuwanshi.com/openapi/processes/{process}/{version}.json`
- [Human-facing repository documentation](https://github.com/hkai-ai/pipipi/tree/main/docs): Design, development, Process, and operations documentation.

## Boundaries

- Product requests contain business input only. The server selects Skills, models, Tools, providers, storage, retries, and execution configuration.
- Use only exact `(process, version)` pairs present in `/openapi.json` (`x-pipipi-processes`). There is no `latest` alias, default Agent, or version fallback.
- `/internal/eval/execute` is a gated internal news-image evaluation endpoint, not a general product interface.
- Never send internal caller or gateway identity headers (`X-Pipipi-Caller-Id`, `X-Pipipi-Gateway-Token`) yourself.
